name: Chair-Supported Quad Stretch
otherNames: Standing Quad Stretch with a Chair
description: Standing tall with one hand on a chair back, bend one knee and hold that ankle behind you, drawing the heel toward your buttock.

source.title: Physitrack: Quads stretch using chair
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand behind a sturdy chair, one hand on its back.
cues: Stand tall; tuck the hips a little.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Hand on the wall
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your left hand on the wall.

keyframes.name: Hold your ankle
keyframes.cue: Grasp your right ankle and draw the heel up and back.
